scope: Bounded Vigilon engineering walk-test branch for the existing 2015 classic EN54 (V4), MCC/MCB V4.53+ profile.

authentication.note: Both values are fictional FINDR-only training credentials. Door/access helpers cannot grant authenticated level 3. Only Test/Eng UserCode recognises the engineering credential.

planner: Pure navigation advice may type the task-appropriate fictional credential. It never traverses On/Off commit actions, resets, alarm controls or configuration commits.
draftPolicy: F3 Cancel clears the uncommitted Zone field in FINDR. F4 Quit and Menu On/Off close the menu/authentication. None removes committed zone test.
runtime: Test fires use the existing five-second deterministic cycle. Finishing a cycle preserves zone test; Off requires restored simulated input. Unrelated fire, faults and disablements persist.
stateCompatibility: The new source fingerprint/map revision starts an old persisted panel snapshot fresh under the existing restore contract; separate completed-lesson records remain owned by the controller.

coverage: physical double-Test route and F2 commit
invalid zone entries and Cancel/Quit/abort preservation
five-second cycle with persistent test selection
active-input Off rejection and unrelated condition preservation
source provenance, numeric field and function-key positions
